verdicts.title: Component Order Connectivity in Directed Graphs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A directed graph D is semicomplete if for every pair x ,  y of vertices of D ,  there is at least one arc between x and y . Thus, a tournament is a semicomplete digraph.
